content: Paul Inai au Macedonia a Achaia
Sabu baisiger sibiyamai on isirimomo gibunai ato Paul on baitutumotis engon iyores siruayo, ato duraiai ikufaiwaris ato auris iyau baitotoris; ato ikirires inai au Macedonia tafanam.
On ato osi tafanam amosi on ibib inai ato dura sigaraba iyawures onai sabu ikufaiwaris. Namon on inat au Achaia tafanamai,
ato on nan roke ton nanaba ima. On ibotitiwagai itan au Syria tafanam mes, ato on isagob Jew yangan on sibidudurai sitasubun mes; ato on inonotai Macedonia tafanam amonai itmatabir men itabib itan.

Sopater, on min Pyrrhus natun, on Berea mafam gagamin orot, Aristarchus a Secundus on Thessalonica sabu; Gaius on Derbe mafam gagamin orot; Timothy, Tychicus a Trophimus on Asia tafanam sabu; osi sabu on Paul mat sinai.
Osi sabu on ainau wei naiyi sinai Troas mafam gagaminai nan simomousi.

Rafi Sarar Men An Fio Yist Auman an forag isawar gibunai wei wa wabo wanai au Philippi mafam gagamin ato ra nim isawar gibunai, wei mat engon Troas mafam gagaminai nan waikaita, ato nan tafaror kaitamom wama.
Paul an Bib Kanfoun on Inai Troas Yangan Ifasiues
Sarire rabirabi on wei waruayo rafi sarar wabaseseb. Paul on sabu auris ibikakafun, ato ra itatom on itan, on mes on dura nana ibikakafun mom inai fom nub basun igat.
Tafa on sigaraba maiau goa ann werominai siyoyour, ato efan menan waruruayo on nan.

Jorei boboun wabin Eutychus on goa kaiawan on nan imair imama, ato Paul on nana ibidur bo on fifi matan ituturub kwakwan, gibui on nousin ifot iyenbubur ato on goa ann weromin emon ifeu au gabur. Osi fifi sibogaiai on irabob nono.
Baise Paul goa emon isur sindan irou ato irous. On iyau, “Omi men woniyababan mes, on on yawasin!”
Namon on imatabir men igai goa ann werominai ato rafi sarar iyabaseseb iyan. Paul osi auris dura ibikakafun mom asir ra itom wera igai weie on ikirires inai.
Osi jorei boboun yawasin sibo sinai au go, ato osi engon men sunub siyasisir on.
Paul Troas emon Inai au Miletus
Wei ainau wanai wa wabo ato warabon wanai au Assos mafam gagamin, wei nan wanai Paul watiwan mes. On iyawurei bobo nanaba watafour yabin on nan ainau annai ibib inai.
Paul on Assos nan igaturei, ato wa’yai ikaruge, mat warabon wanai au Mitylene mafam gagamin.
Wei nan wa wabo wanai ato ra itom on Chios nuaiai nan wagat. Ra tani isawar gibunai wei wanat Samos mafam gagaminai nan wagat, ato ra kaitamom gibunai on wei wanat Miletus mafam gagaminai nan wagat.
Paul inonotai nono on wa inboai Ephesus inikirir totor inan, on men igogoi wera weromin nan Asia tafanamai itama. On ibiyagigin, wera fofoninai itan Jerusalem itgat weie Pentecost an ra itboai.
Paul Ephesus Sabu Kwatus auris Iyau Baitotoris
Paul Miletus mafam gagamin emon on dura iyafar inai Ephesus an ekalesia sabu kwatus auris ibifefeyanis osi nan sitnefotai mes.
Osi sinai sigat ato sabu auris iyau, “Omi wosagob yau bobou nenei anat nin Asia tafanamai on, au wera tutufinai ayein nin mat tama.
Yau ra fufur on atafoum men, maturu auman Bada an agirotiu amatar an bobo aboen, yau yawas wawanin maiau agaturai, yabin Jew yangan on sigogoi yau sitasubunueu mes.
Omi wosagob yau men dura abifan tani omi ami baibais aurin abotan on, yau wasai nan a ami goai nan aurim dura akurereb a aibebeyem.
Yau on Jew yangan a sabu men Jew yangan auris dura wawaninai awures on, God aurin on ya baikitabir sinboai ato ati Bada Iesu sinitutumai.
Ato ari on yau Ayu Kakafotin aurin anifonabo totor wat anan au Jerusalem, men asagob sabu nan on mamaba auriu sinafour.
Yau mafam gagamis engon amosi arur a’gat on Ayu Kakafotin baisosoan dura iyawureu on sabu arimon fafatum goai sinreberueu a auriu bobo komasis sinafour.
Baise yau ari tou au yawas aurin on men anonosin on, bobo gagamin bag on yau au bobo ato Bada Iesu ibiteu on aisawarai, on min God an kaber an Wasagobin on an kurereb.
“Yau on ami tafanam engon abib God an Baiaiwab aurin on dura akurereb. Ato ari on omi men tani arimon magiu initai men.
On mes yau ari dura wawaninai awurem: Omi iyafan tani insisiwan on, yau men bit anboai mes.
Yabin yau on dura engon God an gogoi aifan itafour, on engon tutufin aurim dura akurereb.
Omi toum wonkaifarem tiwag a Ayu Kakafotin bobo item on ami sabu engon wonkaifares tiwag. Omi on kaifarotim God an ekalesia aurin, on atonio bobo ifour on Toun Natun an rabob emon on ininoanai.
Yau asagob anikirirem anan, on arimon kuke tutuenis arimon sanamui sinar, ato foro sheep engon arimon sinikomasis.
Dura bag awurem wera innat arimon sabu toum ami kuayo emon on sinisigogo ato baitutumotis fetagai sininetewaris, ato osi sinigibubunues sinan.
On mes omi wonkaifar, ato wonsagob yau maturu auman fom ra omi engon aibebeyem mom inai kwanda ton nanaba isawar.
“Ato ari omi aurim on yau God imanai ayeyeinin On inkaifarem, ato On an kaber sabu engon auris ebotan on initem.
Yau men iyafan tani an agim gold o silver o ara beber on abasiai atboai on.
Omi toum wosagob, yau tou imaui bobo aboen a yau tuturau mat wabibib asi gogoi aifan on engon yau abites.

Yau bobo engon tutufin aiyoboem on yau tou aboen kwakwan, on etaiai on ot sabu samisamis engon tanibaisis, tannos mamaba Bada Iesu Toun an dura i’yau on, ‘Iyafan ebitai, on aurin on yasisir gagamin, men ato eboai ba.’”
Paul dura ikakafun isawar, ato sabu mat sindas sirou ato sibayoi;
Sabu engon tutufin sitotou a sirorousin rereban siyayanin ato si’yau baitotorai.
Paul an dura ato iyau, gibui men magin sinitai aurin on, sabu engon tutufin siyababan kwakwan. Ato osi mat sinai an wa aurin.
